pull.q: Designed to work as a civilized spring reverb module or an instrument of its own with an open-springs tank.

quotes.t: A DIY build of UralTone's kit — the tank is not part of the kit, so which tank this one has is the seller's to say. Details follow when it is listed for sale.

reviews.title: Spring Reverb kit — the maker's page

blurb.en: UralTone's spring reverb driver and recovery module, a Finnish DIY kit. Not yet for sale.
